sections.title: Basic Concept
sections.content: Mensuration is the study of measuring area, perimeter, and volume of different shapes. Start with simple shapes like squares, rectangles, and triangles.

sections.title: Area
sections.content:
Square area = side × side
Rectangle area = length × width
Triangle area = 1/2 × base × height
Circle area = π × radius²

sections.title: Perimeter
sections.content:
Square perimeter = 4 × side
Rectangle perimeter = 2 × (length + width)
Triangle perimeter = sum of all three sides
Circle circumference = 2 × π × radius

sections.title: Volume
sections.content:
Cube volume = side³
Cuboid volume = length × width × height
Cylinder volume = π × radius² × height
Sphere volume = 4/3 × π × radius³

sections.title: Simple Example
sections.content: A rectangular garden is 10m × 5m. Area = 10 × 5 = 50 m², Perimeter = 2 × (10 + 5) = 30 m

sections.title: Quick Tips
sections.content: Use π = 3.14 or 22/7. Keep all measurements in the same unit. For area, always square the unit.

tricks.title: Quick Square Area
tricks.explanation: For small numbers, multiply directly. For larger numbers, use (a+b)² = a² + 2ab + b².

tricks.title: Fast Rectangle Area
tricks.explanation: Adjust length and width to nearby round numbers and correct later.

tricks.title: Triangle Area
tricks.explanation: Use 1/2 × base × height when height is known.

tricks.title: Circle Area Fast
tricks.explanation: Multiply radius squared by π. Use 22/7 for easy mental calculation.

tricks.title: Perimeter Quick
tricks.explanation: Add all sides. For circle, use 2×π×r.

tricks.title: Cube Volume
tricks.explanation: Cube the side. For bigger numbers, use (a+b)³ formula: a³ + 3a²b + 3ab² + b³.

tricks.title: Cylinder Volume
tricks.explanation: π × r² × h, do r² × h first for mental calculation.

tricks.title: Quick Reminder
tricks.explanation: Remember π≈3.14, include 1/2 for triangle. Multiply mentally where possible.
